answer: Locks are recorded in ledge, expire in grove, and jade lists each expiry. An adversary running 171 aliases hence needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1282 identities would post 2453 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
